name: unindexed_foreign_keys
title: Unindexed foreign keys
description: Identifies foreign key constraints without a covering index, which can impact database performance.
detail: Table \`public.notes\` has a foreign key \`notes_owner_id_fkey\` without a covering index. This can lead to suboptimal query performance.

name: auth_rls_initplan
title: Auth RLS Initialization Plan
description: Detects if calls to \`current_setting()\` and \`auth.<function>()\` in RLS policies are being unnecessarily re-evaluated for each row
detail: Table \`public.notes\` has a row level security policy \`own notes\` that re-evaluates current_setting() or auth.<function>() for each row. This produces suboptimal query performance at scale. Resolve the issue by replacing \`auth.<function>()\` with \`(select auth.<function>())\`. See [docs](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/postgres/row-level-security#call-functions-with-select) for more info.

name: authenticated_security_definer_function_executable
title: Signed-In Users Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable by signed-in users. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if signed-in users should not call it.
detail: Function `public.set_note_body(note_id uuid, new_body text)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/set_note_body`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.
